segments.text:
V. 32.
John came in a way of righteouſneſs—Walking in it, as well as teaching it. The publicans and harlots—The moſt notorious Sinners were reformed, tho' at firſt they ſaid, I will not. And ye ſeeing the amazing Change which was wrought in them, tho' at firſt ye ſaid, I go, Sir, repented not afterward—Were no more convinced than before. O how is this Scripture fulfilled at this Day!
